subject: AWS CPPO: Retail partner launch runway + demo assets
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Dana Morris <dana@retailtech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS CPPO: Retail partner launch runway + demo assets

Hi Dana — great speaking earlier. As discussed, RetailTech is a high-priority channel partner for our retail vertical and we want to get the Channel Private Offer (CPPO) live with a clean go-to-market runway.

High-level asks for the first pass so we can align next week:
- Confirm the SKU(s) you want to publish and which entity will appear on invoices (RetailTech US or RetailTech Global).
- Share any reseller margin targets or required distributor fees so we can model the CPPO discounting logic.
- We will need a recorded 20–30 minute pre-sales demo plus a short slide pack (5–7 slides) for your internal sellers. Can you confirm if your team wants a co-branded asset or fully RetailTech-branded?

I'm attaching a CPPO launch checklist to get us started (internal and partner responsibilities highlighted). Proposed timeline: 2-week enablement runway, pilot PO for the first month, then full listing and co-sell enablement.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync on Tue Jul 20 at 10am PT to confirm SKUs and PO flow. Are you available?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

—
Elliot Price
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.com
Attachment: CPPO_launch_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Dana Morris <dana@retailtech.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: RetailTech Partnerships <partnerships@retailtech.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO: Retail partner launch runway + demo assets

Thanks Elliot — excited to move forward. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) SKUs: We plan to start with two SKUs — "RetailAssist Basic" (monthly seat) and "RetailAssist Scale" (annual seat). I'll attach our internal SKU catalog in the follow-up.
2) Invoicing/entity: RetailTech US will be the invoice entity for the pilot.
3) Margins: We typically target a 20–25% channel margin; we also have a channel rebate program that applies quarterly. Can your CPPO model support rebate pass-through?
4) Demo assets: Co-branded is preferred for the initial enablement; we can provide brand assets. We also need a short demo recording that we can repurpose for field enablement.

We're available Tue Jul 20 10am PT — please send an invite. I'll loop in our procurement lead if we need to share a draft PO.

Regards,
Dana Morris
Head of Partnerships, RetailTech Solutions
dana@retailtech.com
Attachment: retailtech_skus_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dana Morris <dana@retailtech.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO: AWS CPPO launch plan & enablement dates

Hi Dana / team — thanks for the fast turnaround. To keep things actionable, here's a compact plan and owners: 

Week 0 (today): finalize SKUs & invoice entity (RetailTech US) — owner: RetailTech
Week 1: Redwood provides CPPO_launch_checklist + demo asset pack (co-branded), and a draft pricing matrix that shows list, CPPO discount, and reseller net price — owner: Redwood (Ben + Product Ops)
Week 2: Enablement webinar (recorded) + DocuSign PO exchange for pilot month — owner: Redwood + RetailTech procurement
Go-live target: Aug 2, 2027 for pilot listing and first PO fulfillment

I attached the CPPO_launch_checklist.pdf and demo_asset_pack_v1.zip (zipped slides & raw video). On the legal/billing side, please confirm whether RetailTech prefers invoice-to-customer or distributor-pass-through so we can map to AWS settlement correctly.

HubSpot: Deal RDW-CPPO-3481 is already created — https://app.hubspot.com/deal/54321 (please confirm contact owners).

I'll put a calendar invite for Tue Jul 20 10am PT after Elliot confirms.

Best,
Ben Carter
Channel Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachments: CPPO_launch_checklist.pdf (application/pdf); demo_asset_pack_v1.zip (application/zip)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dana Morris <dana@retailtech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace AM <aws-am@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO: Retail partner launch runway + demo assets

Thanks all — a couple of procurement/ops notes to avoid common delays:

- Entity mapping: we need the reseller invoice entity and the AWS payor mapping in the first pass. I've attached an entity_mapping.csv template — please populate and return.
- PO flow: For CPPO pilots we typically do DocuSign for the pilot PO, then switch to AWS Marketplace settlement after activation. RetailTech should confirm billing contact and remit instructions.
- Legal evidence: AWS will require proof of authorized reseller relationship; please provide a reseller agreement or confirmation email that we can forward to AWS AM.
- Margin/rebate: Our billing team needs to know whether the rebate is applied by RetailTech post-settlement or needs to be handled in the CPPO pricing. If it is post-settlement, note it in the PO comments so finance can reconcile.

Action items:
1) RetailTech: populate entity_mapping.csv + send reseller agreement (if available) — owner: Dana
2) Redwood: prepare co-branded demo recording and enablement slide deck — owner: Ben + Product Ops
3) Redwood Finance: confirm invoice path and settlement mapping — owner: Laura (cc'd)

Looping in the AWS AM to ensure CPPO eligibility and to schedule the Marketplace listing window.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
Attachments: entity_mapping.csv (text/csv)

From: Dana Morris <dana@retailtech.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: RetailTech Partnerships <partnerships@retailtech.com>, AWS Marketplace AM <aws-am@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO: Retail partner launch runway + demo assets

Appreciate the clarity — all good from our side. Quick updates: 

- We've attached a signed pilot PO (reseller_po_RetailTech_3481.pdf) that uses RetailTech US as invoice entity.
- Completed the entity_mapping.csv and included our procurement contact.
- Rebate: RetailTech will handle the quarterly rebate post-settlement; we will add a comment on the PO.
- Co-branded demo is preferred — we'll upload brand kit to the shared Drive after this thread.

We accept the Aug 2 pilot go-live target. Please confirm once CPPO is submitted in AWS so we can coordinate the first purchase and settlement test.

Thanks — see you on the Tue Jul 20 10am PT call.

Best,
Dana Morris
Head of Partnerships, RetailTech Solutions
dana@retailtech.com
Attachments: reseller_po_RetailTech_3481.pdf (application/pdf)
